text:
ben (oncall): Quick note — yesterday's P0 DB failure (ticket 23104) woke the crew. We need to run a PIR and assign a facilitator + core attendees. Rough goals: timeline, root cause hypotheses, mitigation review, and assign remediation actions. Who can facilitate? :raised_hand:

olivia (eng): I can chair if nobody else steps up, but I have a client call at 10:00 PT. Best after 11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC onwards for me.

dina (sre): I can facilitate and take notes. Prefer Wed 16:00 UTC or later. I'll also bring the runbook and timeline. Runbook link: https://rwinf.internal/runbooks/db-fail (internal)

ellen (pm): +1 for dina facilitating. I'll join to represent product and customer impact. Please include a short customer-impact summary in the invite.

chun (infra): FYI ops-bot already pulled logs and traces and attached them to the incident. I'll paste timeline artifacts into the doc.

ops-bot: Incident 23104 created: https://incidents.rwinf/23104
- Pager start: 2026-03-12 03:42 UTC
- Impact: increased error rate in write path, region: us-west-2
- Mitigation: blue-green fallback at 03:55 UTC; traffic back to normal by 04:10 UTC

ben (oncall): Thanks. If dina is happy to facilitate, please go ahead and create a calendar invite. We usually keep PIRs to 45 minutes. Also we need an action tracker — GH issues per action are preferred.

dina (sre): I'll create a Doodle to find a time and then make the invite. Doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 (please fill in). Proposed slots: Wed Mar 18 16:00 UTC / Thu Mar 19 00:00 SGT.

ellen (pm): I prefer Wed 16:00 UTC. I'll mark myself as attending. Can we add a 5-10 minute pre-read in the calendar event?

olivia (eng): Wed 16:00 UTC works for me. Request: make the meeting remote-friendly (explicit Zoom link) and mark it recorder-on for notes.

chun (infra): Confirmed Wed. Suggest core attendees: dina, ellen, olivia, chun, ben, mike, tasha. Anyone else?

ben (oncall): Adding mike and tasha to the thread. Mike, Tasha — pinged for attendance and input.

mike (eng): :thumbsup: I can make Wed 16:00 UTC. I'll prepare a short diagram of the service call graph and post relevant metrics.

tasha (cs): I can attend. I'll prepare a customer-impact list (affected accounts, SLAs affected) and copy of outbound comms if needed.

dina (sre): Draft agenda uploaded: https://docs.google.com/drive/link
Agenda highlights:
- 5m: purpose + blameless framing
- 10m: incident timeline (ops + infra)
- 10m: root cause hypotheses and evidence
- 10m: mitigation review and what changed
- 10m: action items and owners
I'll capture notes and action items live in the doc.

ops-bot: Calendar event created by dina: "PIR: DB failure 23104" Wed Mar 18 16:00 UTC — https://calendar.rwinf/event/meeting123

ben (oncall): Two small asks: 1) please make sure at least one participant covers APAC-friendly hours (or record) 2) upload a 1-page pre-read by EOD Mon so attendees can skim.

dina (sre): Pre-read v0.1 uploaded at https://docs.google.com/pre-read — includes timeline, mitigation notes, and initial RCA hypotheses. I'll iterate on Monday with logs/timelines.

olivia (eng): Tiny wording ask — add a blameless statement to the invite: "Goal: learn, assign clear remediation, and prevent recurrence". Keeps tone explicit.

dina (sre): Done. Invite updated with blameless wording and recording enabled.

ben (oncall): Also: who will own the actions tracker after the PIR? We normally convert actions into GH issues and assign owners.

elllen (pm): I'll create GH issues for each action and tag owners, estimate priority, and add ETA columns. (typo fixed: ellen: I'll create...).

chun (infra): I'll own the KV cache tuning follow-up and will open the infra GH task.

mike (eng): I'll own the migration checklist item and open a PR with the staging run.

tasha (cs): I'll follow up on customer comms and sync with account teams.

ben (oncall): Great. I'll keep monitoring the thread in case of conflicts. If anyone can't make Wed, please post alternatives here by EOD tomorrow.

dina (sre): If any attendee needs an alternative slot, add to the Doodle. I'll lock the invite on Tue EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder set: PIR pre-read due Mon Mar 16 23:59 UTC. Reminder will post in #incidents 24h before the event.

ben (oncall): Closing the coordination loop here — thanks all for quick replies. We'll run the PIR Wed Mar 18 16:00 UTC (45m). I'll reopen thread if anything changes. :tada:
